meta.phase-name: Unreal Placement Sync and Diagnostics Workflow

phase-plan.purpose: Define the Unreal plugin workflow that consumes generated level content and supports understandable level-focused authoring workflows in Unreal.
phase-plan.scope: In scope: import payload shape, per-level browsing workflows, optional placement/update rules, diagnostics categories, and ownership boundaries between authored Unreal maps and generated game content. Out of scope: implementing the plugin, selecting exact Unreal class APIs, or completing live map editing.
phase-plan.definition-of-done: Done when the Unreal level workflow, import semantics, and diagnostics rules are explicitly documented for later implementation.

file.description: Plugin baseline that will eventually implement the level content import and authoring workflow.
Shared spatial contract that the Unreal workflow consumes.

task.description: Define the Unreal level content payload and stable id strategy.
Define ownership boundaries between hand-authored Unreal maps and generated level content.
Define diagnostics and the initial useful Unreal workflow semantics.

questions.question: Exact Unreal class resolution rules and editor integration details are deferred until plugin implementation begins.

decision.summary: The plugin should identify generated content by stable generated ids so imported level content can be tracked deterministically if update workflows are enabled.
decision.impact: Keeps future placement/update behavior deterministic without requiring fuzzy matching.

decision.summary: Unreal maps remain hand-authored. The agreed first workflow is hybrid: creators can inspect generated content for a level and drag-drop it into the currently open Unreal level, while optional managed placement/update remains available later for content that benefits from deterministic sync.
decision.impact: Protects manual level design while still allowing the workflow to evolve toward stronger synchronization where it is useful.

decision.summary: The plugin should provide diagnostics first. Missing assets, missing classes, unsupported content, stale generated ids, or transform issues should be understandable from the per-level content browser, and preview/apply update flows can be layered on top for managed content later.
decision.impact: Lets the Unreal workflow start simple and useful while preserving a deterministic upgrade path.

suggestion.gap: REQUIREMENTS.xml does not yet state that the Unreal plugin may start as a per-level content browser and drag-drop workflow rather than requiring auto-placement from the start.
suggestion.proposal: Add a requirement that Unreal integration support a clear per-level content browsing workflow with diagnostics, with auto-placement/update remaining optional and incremental.
